in_marathi.name: Harpreetkaur
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harpreetkaur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harpreet means 'God's Grace' and Kaur is a suffix meaning 'Princess'. This name is derived from the Sikh scripture, Guru Granth Sahib.
